name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v5.87: stock_history is now pruned (180-day retention) on the same 5-minute telemetry sweep that prunes telemetry (90-day). The cleanup statement existed but was never invoked, so stock_history grew unbounded. Confirms the poll path does not append: command-poll last-seen and app-version are keyed upserts (setMeta), one row per machine, so poll frequency has no storage cost. No APK binaries are stored; publish fetches and hashes in memory. Cumulative over v5.86.
